lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct high-contrast vertical line segments are visible on the lateral torso. Spacing is non-uniform, with higher density in the anterior region and significantly wider intervals across the mid-section.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The posterior-most three lines are abbreviated, terminating within the upper 40% of the visible torso height before reaching the medial line.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns exhibit a lyrate spiral trajectory, initiating with a lateral-posterior vector from the skull base and transitioning to a medial-inward vector at the terminal 15% of the structure.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The ratio of the pixel distance between terminal tips to the total horizontal width of the horn bases is approximately 2.1:1.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible white dorsal crest of elongated hair filaments; two distinct white spots located on the posterior mandible/cheek region; white partial chevron on the bridge of the muzzle.
